_help: Template of a RAD IDE service-function pack (docs/CARDIAG.md). Copy it, fill in the identifiers from service information you are entitled to use (manufacturer repair portal, ODX data of your tool, your own measurements), then Car Diagnostics > Service Functions > Import Definition Pack. All identifiers below are PLACEHOLDERS (0000 / FFxx) - replace them. Keys starting with '_' are ignored.
name: My vehicle (template)
source: Where the identifiers come from (document, version, date)

ecus._help: One entry per control unit: physical request id (tx) and response id (rx) in hex, protocol uds or kwp.

dids._help: How to show a data identifier: type num (bytes, signed, scale, offset, unit) | ascii | hex | enum (map).
dids.name: Coolant temperature

routines._help: RoutineControl 0x31: start = 31 01 <rid> <start_params>; poll = 31 03 <rid> every interval_s until a 'done' / 'failed' status byte or timeout_s; stop = 31 02 <rid> <stop.params>. Byte positions in poll / results count from the first byte after the RID. Without 'poll' the answer of the start request is the result.

io_controls._help: InputOutputControlByIdentifier 0x2F: set = 2F <did> <control (default 03 shortTermAdjustment)> <value>; RAD IDE always sends 2F <did> 00 (returnControlToECU) when the test ends, is stopped, or after max_duration_s.

adaptations._help: WriteDataByIdentifier 0x2E <did> <data>: a fixed 'value' (hex) or an 'input' with fields (int: bytes/min/max/scale/offset/unit; enum: options). read_back: compare (read 0x22 and compare) | show | false. The old value is read and kept in the audit log first.
